tests.name: reference index durable transaction boundary captures all five source kinds and projects JSON seeds without writing author state
reference index durable transaction boundary reads durable node Yjs instead of a stale or invalid JSON cache
reference index durable transaction boundary reads durable element Yjs instead of a stale or invalid JSON cache
reference index durable transaction boundary reads durable storyline Yjs instead of a stale or invalid JSON cache
reference index durable transaction boundary reads durable category Yjs instead of a stale or invalid JSON cache
reference index durable transaction boundary combines snapshots and updates and keeps the same source version through compaction
reference index durable transaction boundary distinguishes a revision-zero snapshot from a JSON seed
reference index durable transaction boundary ignores metadata and materialized-cache changes but detects only the changed prose source
reference index durable transaction boundary detects JSON source changes even when updatedAt is unchanged
reference index durable transaction boundary never falls back to JSON when a durable revision has lost its Yjs state
reference index durable transaction boundary preserves previous references when JSON parsing fails
reference index durable transaction boundary preserves previous references when persisted Yjs bytes are malformed
reference index durable transaction boundary rejects unresolved Yjs dependencies instead of indexing a partial document
reference index durable transaction boundary rejects late preparation and replacement after a newer durable prose revision
reference index durable transaction boundary invalidates both generation creation and generation replacement without mutating generations
reference index durable transaction boundary rejects results belonging to a different database or repository owner
reference index durable transaction boundary rejects revoked work even if it was queued before the transaction began
reference index durable transaction boundary rolls back replacement when its owner is revoked during the delete/insert transaction
reference index durable transaction boundary rolls back the deletion if replacement insertion fails and permits retry
reference index durable transaction boundary does not acknowledge a replacement whose commit fails
reference index durable transaction boundary does not resurrect hard-deleted sources and prunes their old references
reference index durable transaction boundary excludes trashed sources and child patches, then reprojects after restore
reference index durable transaction boundary rechecks current existence so an old catalog cannot prune newly created sources
reference index durable transaction boundary keeps writes within the owning project and preserves unsupported source formats
reference index durable transaction boundary rejects changed source incarnations and sources moved to another project
reference index durable transaction boundary captures source rows and Yjs versions in one consistent SQLite transaction
reference index durable transaction boundary clears an empty committed source without changing its prose
reference index durable transaction boundary rejects deleted and recreated project scopes even if entity IDs are reused

limitations: This preparatory repository is not yet connected to ProjectRuntimeProvider or editor reference writes.
Failure injection and SQLite rollback are exercised in-process; process termination and restart recovery are not exercised.
Test durations are diagnostic only, not a renderer performance comparison, database latency budget, or app-wide acceptance.
Catalog reads remain full; source versions and existence are revalidated before every derived replacement.
